items.title: Submit proof of use of the Bauspar loan (invoice or signed order from heating company)
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie den Nachweis binnen 10 Arbeitstagen nach dem Briefdatum ein.
items.computation: Sender is a private company (Bausparkasse), not an authority, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies; the letter explicitly starts the period 'nach dem Briefdatum' (after the letter date), so the anchor is the printed document date itself: 2026-11-21 (a Saturday). The period is 10 Arbeitstage, which the letter itself defines as Montag bis Freitag, gesetzliche Feiertage zählen nicht (German business days, Mon-Fri, public holidays excluded). Counting business days from 2026-11-21 (start day not counted) in NRW: skips Sun 2026-11-22, Sat 2026-11-28, Sun 2026-11-29 (no public holiday falls in this window); 10 business days later lands on Friday 2026-12-04. No weekend/holiday shift is needed since the 10th business day itself is a Friday.

warnings: The letter is from a private Bausparkasse (company), not a public authority, so the statutory 'deemed delivery' rules for authority letters do not apply here; the 10-Arbeitstage period runs from the printed letter date itself, as the letter states.

The letter notes the customer office at Lindenhofer Straße is closed all day on 2026-12-07 for a staff meeting; this is after the computed deadline (2026-12-04) and is not a public holiday, so it does not affect the due date, but it may matter if the proof must be handed in there in person rather than sent by post/email.

If the proof does not arrive in time, the letter states the loan payout will be postponed to the next first of the month (verschiebt sich die Auszahlung auf den nächsten Monatsersten) — a consequence, not an additional deadline to compute.
No amount, payment IBAN relevance, or Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung appears in this letter; the printed IBAN belongs to the lender's own account details and is not a demand for payment from the recipient.
